thread.title: How Texture Acquisition Could Boost Apple’s Services Business

author: Scarlett Ness
title: How Texture Acquisition Could Boost Apple’s Services Business
text: How Texture Acquisition Could Boost Apple’s Services Business More On March 12, 2018, Apple (AAPL) agreed to acquire the Netflix-style magazine subscription service Texture, which gives users access to a host of magazine subscriptions for a flat monthly fee of $9.99. Apple’s purchase of Texture is expected to provide subscribers unlimited access to over 200 magazines including Sports Illustrated, Newsweek, Wired, and Vanity Fair. Apple has reportedly acquired Texture’s staff along with all the company’s assets and resources.
